name: C64 READY Prompt
note: Commodore 64 boot screen: light-blue-on-dark-blue frame, the 38911 BASIC BYTES FREE banner, a typed LOAD"ZORK",8,1 command and a blinking block cursor that hands off to the loader output, then loops.
html:
**** COMMODORE 64 BASIC V2 ****
64K RAM SYSTEM 38911 BASIC BYTES FREE
READY.

name: Spectrum BASIC Listing
note: ZX Spectrum LIST output on white paper: bold tokenised keywords, right-aligned line numbers, a > current-line marker that walks down as lines stream in, and the flashing inverse K keyword cursor on the report line.
html:
10>BORDER 1: PAPER 7: INK 0
20>CLS : LET n=0
30>PRINT AT 10,n;"SPECTRUM"
40>BEEP .04,n: LET n=n+1
50>IF n<24 THEN GO TO 30
60>PAUSE 100
70>GO TO 20
0 OK, 70:1 K

name: Datasette Tape Loader
note: C64 cassette load: the border runs the classic scrolling stripe pattern only while data is streaming, PRESS PLAY blinks first, then FOUND / LOADING with a block meter, tape counter and block count.
html:
DATASETTE 1530 · TAPE 01
PRESS PLAY ON TAPE
░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░
CNT 000 BLK 00/24 300 BAUD

name: Spectrum Colour Bars
note: ZX Spectrum attribute test card: the 8 INK colours in normal and BRIGHT rows with one FLASH cell, plus a loading band that switches from thin cyan/red header stripes to thick yellow/blue data stripes while the byte counter runs.
html:
ZX SPECTRUM 48K · ATTR TEST
01234567
01234567
Program: HORIZONHeader 00000

name: Apple II Text Menu
note: Apple ][ 40-column menu on green phosphor: inverse-video title bar, a selection bar that auto-walks the entries and follows the pointer, the ] prompt with a blinking block cursor, and a scanline overlay.
html:
*** APPLE ][ MAIN MENU ***
1. CATALOG, D1
2. LOAD BINARY FILE
3. MONITOR CALL -151
4. RUN HELLO
] ↑↓ SELECT RET RUN

name: 64K Memory Map
note: Amber-phosphor 64K memory map: box-drawn region rows with hex bases and block-character usage bars, plus a 32-cell 2K-per-cell strip with a scanning cell that drives the live $XXXX address readout.
html:
MEMORY MAP64K
├$0000SYSTEM RAM█░░░░░░░2K
├$0800BASIC PRG█████░░░38K
├$A000BASIC ROM█░░░░░░░8K
├$D000I/O VIC/SID█░░░░░░░4K
└$E000KERNAL ROM█░░░░░░░8K
SCAN $000038911 BYTES FREE

name: POKE / SYS Echo
note: C64 command echo where the POKEs actually take effect: typed POKE 53280/53281/646 lines retint the border, screen and text live, a register panel mirrors $D020/$D021/$0286 in hex with colour swatches, then SYS 49152 and a reset.
html:
REGS
$D0200E
$D02106
$02860E

name: Border Flash Raster
note: Raster IRQ demo card: the border cycles the C64 palette one step at a time while translucent raster bands roll down the screen, with a live $D012 raster-line readout, frame counter and colour ladder.
html:
**** RASTER IRQ V1.2 ****
SYS 49152 : BORDER FLASH ON
$D012=00 FRAME 00000
